svg.title: Liner's web dashboard on a laptop and a phone
svg.desc: The responsive dashboard on a laptop in light mode and a phone in dark mode, touring the Now, Settings and Help tabs together. A new track appears with an Updating screen status; switches flip instantly; the password form opens; the Settings tab shows a QR code with Liner's address.

g.text: Patterns after 5 min of nothing playing
